y = 5x - 4

What is the slope of the line represented by the second equation shown?
problem.stimulus:
Consider the system of equations shown.

y = 3x - 4
y = 5x - 4
problem.question: What is the slope of the line represented by the second equation shown?
problem.explanation: 두 번째 식(y = 5x - 4)의 형태에서 x의 계수가 기울기이므로 기울기는 5이다.
problem.explanationEn: In the second equation (y = 5x - 4), the coefficient of x is the slope, so the slope is 5.
